description: Use this when you need to see exactly what changed between two script versions. Structured geometric delta between two versions of a kernelCAD script — a baseline ({ baseFile } or { baseCode }) and a revision ({ file } or { code }). Returns agent-readable JSON: per-part added/removed/renamed/changed (volume mm³ + exact bbox deltas, numbers matching inspect({ of: 'part-stats' })), total interference-volume delta with per-pair detail, mate-graph changes (added/removed/changed mates incl. type, connectors, pose, limits), and param changes (value/min/max). Single-shape scripts diff as one "(root)" pseudo-part. Use after editing a script to verify exactly what changed physically before re-rendering. Read-only — never touches the active session.

baseFile.description: Baseline script — path to a .kcad.ts file. Hosted server: cannot read files from your machine — pass `code`, or `project:<slug>` for a saved project.

file.description: Revised script — path to a .kcad.ts file. Hosted server: cannot read files from your machine — pass `code`, or `project:<slug>` for a saved project.

name: diff_scripts

deeperDiffAvailable.description: Present when the diff touched geometry-affecting ops: { tool: 'diff_geometry', reason, bodies } — the same two scripts can be compared at material level (added/removed/common volume + per-body verdict).

title: Diff CAD Scripts
